# PointerButton

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum PointerButton
```

A mouse or pen's buttons, as flags.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="none"></a>`None = 0` | No button. |
| <a name="left"></a>`Left = 1` | The primary button. |
| <a name="right"></a>`Right = 2` | The secondary button. |
| <a name="middle"></a>`Middle = 4` | The middle button, often the wheel. |
| <a name="x1"></a>`X1 = 8` | The first side button of a mouse, usually Back. |
| <a name="x2"></a>`X2 = 16` | The second side button of a mouse, usually Forward. |
